name: Danisman Grillhendl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Crispy Fried Chicken in Tirol**

Discover the **Danisman Grillhendl** – a true taste of Tirol! Our **Grillhendl** (roasted chicken) is slow-roasted over wood fire, seasoned with fresh herbs and a touch of Tiroler charm. Juicy, tender, and perfectly crispy, it’s a must-try for every visitor to **Innsbruck**, **Kufstein**, or the **Zillertal**.

Pair it with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** (apple juice spritzer) for the perfect alpine dining experience. Whether you’re in **Lienz**, **Imst**, or **Reutte**, our **Grillhendl** brings the flavors of Tirol to your table.

Visit us in **Tirol** and taste the difference! **Guten Appetit!**
